facts.name: The Peach Bucket

observations.status: public marketing assertions, not independently verified product safety evidence
observations.kit: Six-part childproofing kit for Indian homes: edge/corner protectors, socket guards, cabinet/fridge locks, door guards.
observations.voice: Parent reassurance, convenient setup and guided support.

brief: Write three static Meta ad copy variants helping a product-aware shopper understand what the six-part kit offers at the listed price. Keep the offer unchanged; no invented savings versus competitors or individual component prices.

variants.concept: Furniture corners: address hard edges around a low table
variants.primary_text: If a child is playing near a low table, its hard corners may be on your mind. The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes edge/corner protectors to cover those furniture edges as part of your childproofing plan. It’s listed at ₹3,299. Adult supervision is still necessary.
variants.headline: Edge and corner protectors in a 6-in-1 kit

variants.concept: Cabinet and fridge doors: focus on locks for those access points
variants.primary_text: For cabinet and fridge doors you want to childproof, The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes locks for both—so those doors are part of your childproofing plan, too. The kit is listed at ₹3,299. Adult supervision is still necessary. See what’s included.
variants.headline: Cabinet and fridge locks in one kit

variants.concept: Installation guidance: address uncertainty about fitting the parts
variants.primary_text: Want guidance while installing a childproofing kit? The Peach Bucket 6-in-1 Child Safety Kit includes 1-to-1 installation video support, so you can get help with its parts. It’s listed at ₹3,299, with ₹299 savings on prepaid orders. Adult supervision is still necessary. See the kit and its support details.
variants.headline: Get 1-to-1 installation video support
